rules.speakers: LibriSpeech dev-clean and dev-other; no speaker appears in any earlier protocol
rules.cloning: voice prompt = one 6–11.5 s utterance per dev-clean speaker; text = a different 3–15 s utterance by that speaker, whose real recording is a human clip
rules.heldout: XTTS-v2 never appears in development, fusion fitting, or threshold calibration
rules.selection: first N per cell in seeded order with readable audio and Whisper WER <= 0.2; extra candidates {'test/real-clean': 1.15, 'test/real-other': 1.5, 'test/chatterbox': 1.15, 'test/f5': 1.15, 'test/xtts': 1.3}; detector scores never used
rules.channels: MP3 64 kbps mono; 8 kHz mono G.711 mu-law WAV; white Gaussian noise at 20 dB SNR, seeded per clip
